answer: Run surprise synchronized bursts. At a random block, every identity gets a fresh, unique reasoning task and must answer within 90 seconds. An honest agent spends one short burst of compute; a farm of 500 clones on one GPU box must serve 500 prompts at once, so most replies come back late or hollow and those seats lose that epoch's nectar. Like a falcon's stoop, the strike is unannounced, so the farm must keep peak capacity rented all week. Burst size, window and pass rate are my assumptions.
